name: Remix Remix Koerner Hall - 1780 Stein-Schule Fortepiano & Spatial Acoustics
description: Interactive 3D acoustic simulation of Toronto's Koerner Hall featuring a CAD-reconstructed c. 1780 Stein-Schule South German fortepiano, 5 synchronized solo Creative Commons period fortepiano recordings, and seat-dependent room acoustics across 1,135 seats.
